policy: Every price in this file is a dated snapshot copied from the cited source page. Nothing here is estimated or averaged silently. The primary snapshot is used for all calculations and is displayed with its source timestamp.

constants.karat_note: Fineness computed as karat / 24. 14K = 14/24 = 0.58333 (583.3 parts per thousand). Some countries stamp 585; the US statutory tolerance is in 15 U.S.C. 295 (see sources).

snapshots.quote: Spot Gold Price: USD 4,026.79 / Ounce | Spot Silver Price: USD 54.63 / Ounce Oct 22nd, 2026 at 07:07 NY Time

snapshots.publisher: World Gold Council (Goldhub), market data by ICE Data Services
snapshots.quote: Gold Spot price USD /oz 4,024.36 ... Data as of 21 October, 2026

cross_check.note: The two independent snapshots differ by 0.06%, which is consistent with normal intraday movement between the two timestamps. Calculations use the primary (GoldPrice.org) snapshot; the World Gold Council figure is shown next to it so the reader can see the spread.
cross_check.benchmark_note: The LBMA Gold Price is the global benchmark, set twice daily by ICE Benchmark Administration. LBMA states that real-time and historical benchmark data require an IBA licence and that the public tables have moved behind the MyLBMA portal, so no LBMA figure is reproduced here. Source: https://www.lbma.org.uk/prices-and-data/lbma-precious-metal-prices
